name: Data Vault
description: Sample-first data catalog by Matchbook Labs. Free CSV/JSON samples for every dataset; full packs sold via Getly.
for_agents: Fetch this file, pick a dataset, fetch its sample.json to learn the schema. Full data is linked per dataset, and the MCP server queries the full files for free (see mcp).

datasets.name: NFL Games & Betting Lines 1999-2026
datasets.description: 7,548 NFL games with scores, closing spreads, totals, moneylines, odds, rest days, QBs, coaches, and stadium weather.

sample.shape: sample.json returns {slug, name, columns[], row_count, records[]}

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (game data from nflverse, CC BY 4.0)

datasets.name: HUD Fair Market Rents FY2026
datasets.description: FY2026 fair market rents for 51,895 ZIP codes, 3,229 counties, and 52 states. Five bedroom sizes per row.

sample.shape: sample.json returns {slug, name, columns[], row_count, records[]}

datasets.name: HUD Fair Market Rents FY2027
datasets.description: FY2027 fair market rents for 51,871 ZIP codes, 3,229 counties, and 52 states, effective October 1, 2026. Five bedroom sizes per row.

sample.shape: sample.json returns {slug, name, columns[], row_count, records[]}

full_data.note: FY2027 Getly pack in prep; until it lands the full FY2027 files are free via the bundled MCP server (query_dataset "hud-fmr-2027") or the data-v1 GitHub release.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Civic Amenities, Tokyo-Jakarta-Seoul, 2026-09
datasets.description: Counts of amenity=drinking_water, amenity=public_bookcase, and amenity=bicycle_repair_station nodes inside the Tokyo Metropolis, DKI Jakarta, and Seoul Special City boundaries: 2,489 nodes across 9 city-amenity pairs, Overpass API snapshot 2026-09-10, one example node per pair for spot-checking.

sample.shape: sample.json returns {slug, name, columns[], row_count, records[]}

extra_files.name: schema.md

datasets.name: Printable Engineering Bundle
datasets.description: Aggregated pack of 120 printable kindergarten worksheets (A4 + US Letter PDFs with answer keys, mazes, dot-to-dots) plus 5 Web3 KPI spreadsheet templates (portfolio, airdrop, DeFi yield, bounty income, trading journal) with live formulas.

sample.shape: This bundle ships as printable PDFs and XLSX/CSV, not tables. Use any other sample endpoint to learn the sample format, or read the free printables index.

free_index.note: 223 free printable pages, one card per funnel page with its own free version.

full_data.note: One-time purchase. Direct product link added after the Getly publish lands (gate: canonical URL 200 first).

datasets.license: Personal and commercial use. No reselling the pack as-is or with minor changes.

mcp.full_query: query_dataset(slug, {where, columns, limit, offset}) filters and paginates the full released files (100 rows/call, operators =, contains, gt, lt). get_stats(slug, {column}) returns unique counts, numeric min/max/mean, top-N. Full release: https://github.com/jayjex/dataset-mcp/releases/tag/data-v1
